name: dw at end of line keeps the newline
dw in middle of line deletes one word
d$ deletes to end of line
d0 deletes back to column 0
dj deletes two lines linewise
dG deletes from cursor to end of file
dfx deletes through the x
dt) deletes up to but not including the paren
d% deletes to matching paren
d2w deletes two words across line end
cw changes a word
cw on a blank changes only one blank
c$ changes to end of line
cb changes the word before the cursor
c2j changes two lines linewise
yw then p pastes after the end of line
yj copies two lines then p pastes below
y$ then 0 then P pastes before the line start
ye yanks to end of word then P pastes it
yw on empty line does not change text
yb at line start yanks from previous line
dd on last line moves cursor to previous line
dd on only line leaves an empty buffer
3dd near end deletes the remaining lines
2yy then P pastes two lines above
cc on indented line replaces the whole line
dd on empty line removes it
x at end of line moves cursor left
x on empty line does nothing
X at column 0 does nothing
3x past end deletes to end of line
X in middle deletes previous character
r replaces one character
3rx replaces three characters
5rx with too few characters left does nothing
D deletes from cursor to end of line
C changes from cursor to end of line
Y yanks whole line then p pastes below
J joins two lines with one space
J strips leading whitespace of the joined line
3J joins three lines
J on last line does nothing
u undoes dd
<C-r> redoes an undone dd
u after several x changes undoes only the last
u restores character deleted by x
p after dw pastes after cursor
P before cursor pastes deleted word
p after dd pastes line below current line
"ayy stores line in a then "ap pastes it
"Ayy appends a line to register a
"_dd does not overwrite the unnamed register
"0 still holds last yank after dd
"1 holds last deleted line after dd
"2p after two linewise deletes pastes the first deleted line
"aP pastes charwise word stored by "ayw
"_x does not overwrite the unnamed register
"bdw stores word in b then "bp pastes it
"Ayw appends charwise text to register a
register a survives a later unnamed yank
